messages:
maria: Post-incident follow-up: last night we saw recurring p99 spikes on /generate correlated with a recent canary that disabled KV caching for long prompts. Need fast remediation plan + SLO guardrails.

leo: What were the numbers?

maria: p95 from ~110ms -> 260ms, p99 from ~390ms -> ~1.2s during peak. Throughput steady.

prashant: Confirmed. Canary flipped KV_TTL=0 for ~10% traffic. Trace sampling shows big KV miss bursts.

maria: Proposed actions:
- R1 revert canary TTL override for canary only (owner: prashant, target: tonight).
- R2 add KV hit/miss ratio and p99-by-endpoint panels to SLO dashboard (owner: leo, target: 48h).
- R3 temporary SLO relaxation: p99 cap to 900ms for 7 days and pause non-critical feature rollouts if error-budget burn >20% (owner: tara, target: 2024-05-09).
- R4 create automated detector: if p99 > 2x baseline for 15m, create high-priority alert (owner: maria, target: 2024-05-06).

leo: PromQL for miss ratio I'll use: ```sum(rate(redwood_inference_kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_inference_kv_request_total[5m]))``` will surface 1m/5m variants by region.

tara: For the SLO text: "Temporary SLO: /generate p99 permitted <=900ms for 7 days starting when revert is deployed. If error-budget burn exceeds 20% in that window, suspend public rollouts and trigger SLO review." I'll draft governance PR.

prashant: Revert plan: push revert to canary, observe 6h; if p99 improves to <700ms unpause. I'll add a TTL-variant request tag in canary to correlate.

maria: Dashboard runbook (to attach to ticket): 1) KV miss ratio by prefix, 2) p99 /generate by region, 3) GPU queue length. If after revert p99 <700ms in 6h, unpause error budget.

leo: I'll add panels + a small runbook note and request-size distribution panel (long prompts correlate with higher misses).

sre-bot: Incident 2024-05-01-2311: status set to "followup". Owners: prashant, leo, tara.

maria: I'll open the follow-up ticket with checklist: revert PR, canary instrumentation, dashboard panels, temp SLO PR, synth monitors, observation window.

prashant: Revert targeted for tonight's window. Will post update here.

leo: ack, will push panels in 48h.

tara: ack, will draft SLO PR and include rollback criteria (p99 >850ms for 30m triggers escalation).

maria: Thanks all. We'll review status in tomorrow's handoff and SLO sync next week.

sre-bot: Reminder: SLO governance sync scheduled 2024-05-07 16:00 UTC"
